name: VibeCheck MCP Server
description: An AI-powered security audit tool that analyzes codebases for vulnerabilities using real-time MITRE CWE data and npm audit. It enables users to perform comprehensive scans for authentication issues, exposed secrets, and dependency risks with structured remediation steps.
